transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... ever since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve just been a lot more on edge and down than usual. I find myself snapping over little stuff around the house, and then I end up showing up to class or the shop already completely drained. 

I mean, I’m still getting by, mostly. But I’ve missed a couple of deadlines recently, and I even had to back out of helping build the theater set because I just couldn't keep everything straight in my head anymore.
About how long ago did your sister and her baby move back in?
It's been about a month now. Yeah, right around a month since they moved back into the house.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I still like doing the same stuff I usually enjoy. I mean, like I said, I had to drop out of helping with the theater set, but that wasn't because I didn't want to do it... I just didn't have the energy or focus for it right now. But when I actually have a minute to myself, I still enjoy working on my own projects and hanging out. I haven't really lost interest, I'm just... distracted, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or depressed for most of the day, nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I definitely feel more stressed and maybe a little down sometimes, but it's not like an all-day, every-day kind of thing. It's mostly just when things get chaotic at the house or I'm feeling overwhelmed with everything I have to do. When things are quiet, I feel pretty normal.
Before your sister and her baby moved back in, were you already dealing with these feelings of anxiety or low mood?

No, I was actually doing okay before they came back. Things were pretty normal for me. It really only started getting bad, you know, within a couple weeks of the house getting so crowded with my sister and the baby. That's when all this stress and trouble started.
